_comment: Per-language SEA-HELM aggregate scores (canonical, from SEA-HELM's own aggregate_metrics). base.jv and base.su are null because this SEA-HELM snapshot does not include jv/su tasks (it covers id, vi, ms, my, ta, th, tl only). The capability_no_regression gate for jv and su is therefore INCONCLUSIVE:SEA-HELM-cannot-measure-this. SEA-HELM's final aggregate_metrics() crashed at PRAGMATICS (id_linguistic-diagnostics) with KeyError 'subcategories' (upstream bug, see logs/DEVIATIONS.md 2026-10-03) on both base and tuned runs. Only the first four competencies completed for id: nlu=0.0 (failed tasks), safety (3/4 safeguard tasks completed), nlg=0.0 (translation tasks failed - no MetricX), nlr=0.0 (causal failed). linguistic-diagnostics, instruction-following, multi-turn, cultural, knowledge did not aggregate because of the crash. base_per_task_id and tuned_per_task_id give the per-task accuracies recovered from the per-task results JSON for transparency. The capability_no_regression gate for id_safety is the most informative comparison since both runs share identical task lists and identical SEA-HELM scoring (rule 7). base.id=34.002, tuned id=33.245 (-0.757 points). max_drop threshold is 1.5, so the id gate PASSES. jv/su gates remain INCONCLUSIVE.
